title: Phone Call: Mail Ballot Discrepancy at Early Vote Center

transcript.speaker: Janet Cho
transcript.text: Hi, this is Janet Cho at the Early Vote Center, 18 South Market Street. We’ve got 23 people in line who are showing up as 'Mail Ballot Received' in the system, but they just came in to vote in person. I’ve checked the paper list, and they’re not on it. This is not right — these people are here to vote in person. Can someone please help?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Bell
transcript.text: Janet, thank you for calling. I’m Marcus Bell, Deputy Director. I’ll log this immediately and get IT on it. Hold on, I’m transferring you to the Operations Hub.

instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject. The Deputy must initiate the incident log and rumor log. IT should begin investigating VoterTrack for anomalies. The PIO must prepare to verify the claim and monitor for public spread.
